moduleTitle: Module 5. Renal, Digestive, Metabolic, Immune and Reproductive Physiology

competencies.name: Four digestive processes
competencies.can: Distinguish motility, secretion, digestion, and absorption and identify where in the tract each dominates.

competencies.name: Motility patterns
competencies.can: Compare peristalsis, segmentation, and the migrating motor complex by pattern and purpose.

competencies.name: Neural and hormonal regulation
competencies.can: Explain short and long reflex control by the enteric nervous system and match gastrin, secretin, cholecystokinin, and glucose dependent insulinotropic peptide to their stimulus and action.

competencies.name: Phases of digestive control
competencies.can: Describe the cephalic, gastric, and intestinal phases and state the dominant control mechanism in each.

competencies.name: Gastric secretion and mucosal protection
competencies.can: Trace the production of hydrochloric acid by the parietal cell and explain how the mucosal barrier protects the stomach and how ulcers develop when it fails.

competencies.name: Pancreatic and biliary secretion
competencies.can: State the components of pancreatic juice and bile and explain how bicarbonate neutralizes chyme and how bile salts emulsify fat.

competencies.name: Carbohydrate and protein digestion and absorption
competencies.can: Trace a starch and a protein from mouth to bloodstream naming the enzymes at each step and the transport mechanism at the brush border.

competencies.name: Lipid digestion and absorption
competencies.can: Trace a triglyceride through emulsification, lipase action, micelle formation, and chylomicron packaging to the lymphatic route and explain why fat takes a different path than glucose.

competencies.name: Liver function and enterohepatic circulation
competencies.can: State the metabolic, storage, and detoxification functions of the liver and trace the enterohepatic circulation of bile salts.

competencies.name: Large intestine and microbiome
competencies.can: Describe water and electrolyte absorption in the colon, the contribution of the microbiome, and the defecation reflex.

competencies.name: Digestive enzyme experiment
competencies.can: Test the effect of pH, temperature, and substrate on a digestive enzyme and relate the results to the region of the tract where that enzyme works.
